exclusionReasons.reason: missing status, missing follow-up time, or non-positive follow-up

meta.discriminationThreshold: Youden's J statistic (maximizes sensitivity + specificity − 1), computed once on the evaluable cohort for that feature. The survival endpoint's concordance index needs no threshold — it directly measures ranking agreement between the feature and observed survival time.

unavailable.note: Not available for this cohort. The radiomics extraction was delivered as a flat per-patient feature table with no accompanying scanner model, field strength, sequence, or reconstruction parameters.
Not available for this cohort. No record of segmentation method (manual, semi-automated, or automated) or of which reader/tool produced each contour was provided alongside the features.

unavailable.topic: Feature stability across scanners, protocols, or segmentation methods
unavailable.note: Cannot be assessed — this would require repeat scans, repeat segmentations, or protocol/site labels, none of which exist in the source files. The fold-stability percentages shown elsewhere in this app describe robustness to cross-validation resampling, a different property from robustness to acquisition variation.

familyGroups.interpretation: Tumor size, compactness, irregularity, elongation, and surface complexity.

familyGroups.interpretation: Overall signal intensity and intensity variability within the region.
Intratumoral heterogeneity, uniformity, coarseness, or local contrast.
The same first-order and texture measures recomputed on wavelet- or Laplacian-of-Gaussian-filtered images, capturing imaging patterns at different spatial scales.
Peritumoral vascular burden, geometry, tortuosity, and heterogeneity, computed on the vessel region independently of the tumor region.
Spatial organization of tumor and surrounding vasculature (e.g. joint or relational measures between the two regions).
familyGroups.note: Not present in this feature set. Tumor and vessel features were extracted independently per region; no joint tumor–vessel spatial-relationship features were computed.
